user.title: Connect GHL ProfiLux
user.description: The GHL API must be enabled on the device (System → GHL API) and the firmware must be 7.52 or newer.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the address and close other programs that hold the API port.
error.no_access: The GHL API is switched off on the device (enable it under System → GHL API).
error.outdated: The firmware is too old. Version 7.52 or newer is required.
